seo.title: Numbers Greater Than 75 Speed Grid - Number Comparison
seo.metaDescription: Find every number strictly greater than 75 on a 100-tile grid. Practice inequality symbols and magnitude comparison in a fun speed challenge.
seo.intro: Comparing numbers using magnitude and inequality relations (greater than and less than) is an essential milestone in primary mathematics. The numbers strictly greater than 75 are situated in the bottom quarter of the 100 chart, consisting of numbers 76 through 100. This game reinforces rapid evaluation of inequality boundaries on visual charts.
seo.howToPlay: Click all numbers that are strictly greater than 75 (values 76 to 100). Correct numbers highlight green with a checkmark. Clicking 75 or any smaller number causes a red flash and a 2-second penalty. Find all 25 numbers to win.
seo.teacherNotes: Reinforce that "greater than 75" does not include 75 itself. Review the strict inequality symbol > versus the inclusive inequality symbol >=.

faq.q: Is 75 included when finding numbers greater than 75?
faq.a: No, "greater than 75" means strictly larger than 75, so the smallest valid target is 76.
